description: Simulate dropping OS files onto the element identified by ref or selector. Web DataTransfer mode: reads each path on the host running the server, rebuilds the files in the renderer, and dispatches dragenter/dragover/drop with a real DataTransfer — engaging standard web drop handlers. Paths must be ABSOLUTE (max 10 files, 5242880 bytes each). default_prevented reports whether a drop handler engaged (called preventDefault); false usually means the target has no web drop handler. Apps that resolve dropped files to native OS paths need an app-specific IPC convention this tool does not simulate. Options: mimeType, timeoutMs. Returns: { ok, session_id, target, files, default_prevented }. Errors: ABSOLUTE_PATH_REQUIRED, FILE_NOT_FOUND, BAD_ARGUMENT (too many/large files, or ref+selector both), SELECTOR_NO_MATCH / REF_NOT_FOUND (carries similar_refs), NOT_RUNNING.

mimeType.description: MIME type override applied to every file (defaults to extension-based).

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

timeoutMs.description: Actionability budget in ms (default 5000, clamped to 30000).

name: electron_drop_file
title: Drop files onto an element
